_note: Delegatie- en mandaatregister (bevoegdheidstoedelingen) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for the bevoegdheidstoedeling register; schema refs BY SLUG (bevoegdheidstoedeling), never the PascalCase key Bevoegdheidstoedeling (multi-word schema — the exact silent-breakage case). The 'geldig op' (in-force-on-date) filter and the ondermandaat chain display are wired by Task 4 (imperative filter/chain UI); this fragment provides the declarative page skeleton, quick filters on status/type, and mass export.

config._note: Delegatie- en mandaatregister index (REQ-DMR-004). Columns type/delegans/delegataris/onderwerp/geldigVanaf/geldigTot/status; quick filters on status and type. Per-delegans (body or role), per-delegataris (body, function, or person), full-text search over onderwerp/beperkingen/delegataris description, and the 'geldig op' in-force-on-date filter (status van-kracht AND geldigVanaf <= X AND (geldigTot empty OR geldigTot >= X)) are wired as a pure OR list query by Task 4 — no per-row resolution service, no N+1. CSV export via the shared ExportService + CnMassExportDialog (mass-export exposed by the index chrome) includes type, delegans, delegataris, onderwerp, financieelPlafond, wettelijke grondslag, besluit, geldigheid, and status.

BevoegdheidstoedelingDetail (REQ-DMR-003/004/005/006). Toedeling data leads 8-wide, publication stacked right; the linked delegans/delegatarisBody/delegatarisPersoon/besluit/ingetrokkenDoor/parentToedeling render as resolved references in the data + Related widgets. The Related widget also surfaces the ondermandaat chain (parent link + list of ondermandaten, keyboard-navigable, depth walked from the loaded chain — never stored) and the reverse lookup of decisions referencing this toedeling as bevoegdheidsgrondslag (REQ-DMR-006). Files leaf for the scanned mandaatbesluit PDF. Audit trail is a sidebar tab. The publish/withdraw actions (setting publicationDate/depublicationDate) and the chain display are wired by Tasks 4-5.
